summary: Two hikers from Texas attempting Mt. Massive off-trail from Hagerman Pass became lost after reaching about 14,000 feet and turning around; they slept on rocks overnight, then split at about 4 a.m. — one made it back to Skinner Hut and called SAR, while the other, too dehydrated to move, later found a stream and walked back to Skinner Hut himself, calling dispatch about 6:30 p.m. Lake County SAR searched about eight hours and Flight for Life flew aerial reconnaissance without spotting him; he had spent more than 36 hours outside.
location: Mt. Massive, Hagerman Pass approach (Skinner Hut area)
